manual.title: Manual Setup and Instructions
manual.description:
### Configuration and Liberation Instructions

Configure your Chuangmi / Xiaomi camera to enable **zero-lag live WebRTC streaming** and local UDP control.

*(If your camera was already integrated via Xiaomi Miot, detected parameters were automatically filled below).* 

---
#### Parameter Guide:
- **Device ID (DID):** Numeric device identifier from Xiaomi Cloud (9-10 digits).
- **Local IP:** IP address assigned to the camera on your local LAN (e.g. `192.168.1.50`). Enables local streaming and instant controls without cloud dependency.
- **miIO Token (32 hex):** 32-character encryption key for local UDP control (night mode, status LED, privacy mode).
- **Model:** Camera hardware identifier (e.g. `chuangmi.camera.ipc019e`).
